question: What kind of out-of-domain data?
title: Predicting Annotation Difficulty to Improve Task Routing and Model Performance for Biomedical Information Extraction
answer_rationale: Text 3 (page=1, section=Abstract) states that the difficulty prediction model combines a 'universal' encoder trained on out-of-domain data and a task-specific encoder. This directly identifies 'out-of-domain data' as the type of data used to train the universal encoder.
